candidate.user_submission: This child is 18 months old and has fever for 2 days. The temperature measured is 38.0°C. The child is able to drink or breastfeed. The child is not convulsing now, and there has been no history of convulsions. The child is not lethargic or unconscious. The child does not vomit everything. There is no cough or difficult breathing. There is no diarrhoea. There is no ear problem. The child has not had measles within the last 3 months. There is no generalized rash, no red eyes, and no runny nose. There is no obvious cause of fever seen. There is no stiff neck. There is no identified bacterial cause of fever in this assessment. This is not a malaria risk area and there has been no travel to a malaria risk area.
